title: Electron count with a double charge
hints: Use valence electrons rather than atomic numbers.
statement:
How many valence electrons must a Lewis structure of $\ce{CO3^2-}$ contain?

[_]{a}

explanations: 4 from carbon, 18 from oxygen, and 2 extra.
This omits both electrons added by the ion charge.
This does not follow from the main-group valence counts.
